title: Designer UX audit: accessibility, keyboard shortcuts, zoom controls, property panels
body:
Comprehensive UX analysis of all 5 designers in `plugin-designer` with Phase 1 improvements implemented. Full analysis in `DESIGNER_UX_ANALYSIS.md`.

## Accessibility (all designers)
- `aria-label` on every icon-only button
- `role="toolbar"` / `role="region"` / `role="tablist"` on interactive regions
- `aria-selected` on ViewDesigner tab buttons

## Keyboard shortcuts (Page, DataModel, Process, Report)
- `Delete`/`Backspace` removes selected item (skipped when focus is in input/textarea)
- `Escape` deselects

## PageDesigner
- Functional zoom controls (−/+/fit) replacing the static percentage label
- Editable label field in property panel

## DataModelDesigner
- `🔑` emoji → `PK` text for primary key indicator
- "coming soon" tooltip on non-functional Add Relationship button

## ReportDesigner
- Property panel now shows element type, position, size, and text/field values

## CollaborationProvider
- New `ConnectionStatusIndicator` component with live connection state dot + user count
- User color palette expanded 8 → 16

```tsx
import { ConnectionStatusIndicator } from '@object-ui/plugin-designer';

// Renders: 🟢 Connected (3 users)
<CollaborationProvider config={config} user={user}>
  <ConnectionStatusIndicator className="absolute top-2 right-2" />
  <PageDesigner />
</CollaborationProvider>
```

## Empty states
All designers now include actionable guidance text instead of bare "nothing here" messages.

## ROADMAP
Added section **2.8 Designer UX Enhancement** with 4-phase plan (Phase 1 ✅, Phases 2–4: DnD, undo/redo, i18n, collaboration wiring).
